images.alt: The OPNsense sign-in page, with the Username and Password fields and the Login button.
images.caption: Sign in to your firewall.

images.alt: System: Access: Users, listing existing accounts, with the Users and ApiKeys tabs above the table and the orange + button below it.
images.caption: System > Access > Users. The + button below the table adds an account.

images.alt: System: Access: Privileges, showing the searchable list of privilege names that can be granted to an account.
images.caption: System > Access > Privileges. Grant only the three read-only privileges.

images.alt: The ApiKeys tab of System: Access: Users, showing an empty table with Username, Api key and Commands columns. The tab lists issued keys only; it has no button that creates one.
images.caption: The ApiKeys tab lists existing keys. It does not create them — keys are issued from the user’s own edit form.

images.alt: System: Trust: Certificates, listing the certificates held by the firewall, including the self-signed web GUI certificate, with per-row export controls.
images.caption: System > Trust > Certificates. Export the web GUI certificate as PEM.
